fields.summary_ko.0: iShares Future AI & Tech ETF (ARTY), an AI technology-focused ETF, fell 17.1% over the past 30 days, entering a correction phase, while semiconductor ETFs also plunged 12.1% on November 5.
fields.summary_ko.1: NVIDIA fell 4.27% on November 9 and 6.5% on November 10 amid governance concerns, but IDC survey results show Q2 global AI infrastructure spending reached $121.4 billion, up 53.3% year-over-year, indicating steady long-term demand.
